## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days, if frequent relapse, PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Not specified |
| **G6PD deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision and access to transfusion services |
| **If no testing available** | Based on risk-benefit assessment | Not specified |
